# Hypersun

> Hypersun is building an AI operating system for independent power producers and battery storage operators. Laplace is its AI operations agent, bringing plant data, physics, and forecasting together to support operating decisions.

- Company scope: independent power producers across solar, wind, hydro, thermal and mixed generation portfolios, alongside battery storage operators. Models and integrations beyond the current solar prototypes are scoped with each engagement.
- Working prototypes: a solar digital twin using recorded NREL plant data and a solar forecasting harness. The demo includes simulated faults and synthetic operational workflows.
- In development: operator-reviewed maintenance recommendations and battery charge/discharge scheduling. Autonomous control and cross-owner energy trading are not available in the current demo.
- Engagement: audit one plant, quantify potential improvements, run a scoped pilot, and expand based on measured results.
- Ambition: operate over 1 TW by 2035, with longer-term coordination of independently owned generation and storage. This is a future target, not current capacity.

## Pages

- [Home](https://hypersun.si/): product and pilot overview
- [Laplace](https://hypersun.si/laplace.html): working demo and capability status
- [HypersunBench](https://hypersun.si/hypersunbench/): October 2026 solar forecasting evaluation, 213 plants, 44 GW of evaluated capacity and 2.4 million predictions. Hypersun v1 ranks first among evaluated models on overall day-ahead and intraday CRPS skill relative to smart persistence.
- [Who it’s for](https://hypersun.si/who.html): independent power producers and battery storage operators
- [Start a plant audit](https://hypersun.si/contact.html): discuss a site and scope a pilot
